subject.title: feat: add portable table presentation blocks

question: Should `table` become the next permanent portable presentation block, following the existing chart precedent, with Slack-native rendering and deterministic fallback ownership across channel plugins?
rationale: The linked umbrella identifies this as remaining work, but adding a public plugin SDK contract and requiring all channel adapters to preserve its semantics is a permanent product boundary that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve portable table API
options.body: Accept the public `table` block after current-main review refresh and real Slack native plus fallback proof.

options.title: Keep tables Slack-owned
options.body: Narrow the branch to Slack-specific rendering without adding a portable plugin SDK block.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the API and leave the umbrella issue open until a different producer boundary is selected.

recommendation.title: Approve portable table API
recommendation.body: Accept the public `table` block after current-main review refresh and real Slack native plus fallback proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter established the portable-chart precedent, documented tables as the remaining direction, and has the strongest history on the affected public and Slack surfaces.
